title: Surface required level-up choices and explicitly block unsupported ones
description: Mirror requiredChoices.ts for leveling: surface the choices a level-up requires (ASI vs feat, subclass selection, spells learned/known/prepared, expertise) as explicit required-choice descriptors, reusing the existing 'choices keyed by generated descriptors' pattern from character creation. Crucially, level-up must FAIL CLOSED: where a granted level requires a choice the engine cannot yet apply deterministically — notably new cantrips/spells/slots/preparation — block it with an explicit reason rather than inferring or silently skipping it. Note the creation-time seam deliberately does NOT do this (the draft engine's mechanical-choice gate covers only skills/tools/equipment/languages, and the wizard treats empty spell input as finalizable); do not copy that lenient behavior into leveling.
acceptance_criteria: Required level-up choices are enumerated from pack data; supported choices are applied deterministically; unsupported choices are blocked with a clear, explicit reason; tests cover a class that needs a subclass and one that needs a spell choice.
notes: Groundwork landed in .8 (PR #340): detectLevelUpRequiredChoices(sheet) + LevelUpRequiredChoicesError in character/levelUpEngine.ts already detect & fail-closed-block subclass/ASI/fighting-style/expertise/class-feature/spell-learning levels (conservative denylist by feature-ref suffix + spell-capacity deltas). .9 replaces that denylist with structured required-choice descriptors (mirror requiredChoices.ts) + accepted choice inputs so these levels can actually complete; applyLevelUp should consume the resolved choices instead of unconditionally throwing.
close_reason: Implemented structured level-up choice descriptors, deterministic subclass selection, and explicit unsupported blockers for spell/other choices.
